name: Ministers
overview: Scripture presents ministers as those set apart to serve God and His people with holiness and dedication, as exemplified by Aaron and his sons who were appointed to minister in the priest's office (Exodus 28:1). Their role involves a solemn commitment to purity and reverence, symbolized by the command to maintain holiness and avoid defilement (Exodus 28:36; Leviticus 10:9; 21:6). Ministers are also to be supported and encouraged in their service, as shown by the provision for priests and Levites to be strengthened in the law of the LORD (2 Chronicles 31:4). The encounter of Isaiah with the holy God underscores the high calling and the need for ministers to recognize their own unworthiness and the holiness required in their service (Isaiah 6:5).
